entries.author: narrator
entries.content:
LOCATION: old keep of Vhalanth, interior crumbling arches  
SIGIL: ancient sigil at center glows faintly now cracked  
POOL: black water at sigil location remains present  
ENEMY: gaunt hooded figure with glowing crimson eyes has emerged, currently present  
CURSE: figure has hurled a doom-promising curse echoing throughout stone complex, affecting all present who linger too long  
UNRESOLVED_CONSEQUENCE: curse remains active; no cure or neutralization indicated yet

entries.author: party
entries.content:
Enemy hooded figure present.  
Cracked sigil present.  
Stone beneath sigil present.  
Pool beneath or around sigil present.  
Party intends to strike stone or pool to disrupt enemy power before curse fully takes hold.  
Enemy is drawing fire.

entries.author: narrator
entries.content:
Party is located near an ancient sigil carved into mottled stone with a black pool at its base.  
Enemy hooded figure is present, alive, eyes blood‑red, and is drawing fire toward the sigil crack.  
The sigil has cracks snake across the stone, emits a faint glow, is cursed, and causes a low eerie hum.  
The black pool is dark, shimmers briefly, then returns to murky depth; damage ripples in its surface.  
A tremor rattles the arches, causing more cracks to spread across the cold stone.  
Fire is drawn by the hooded figure onto the sigil crack, with its glow thickening with each pulse.  
The enemy's eyes produce an oppressive click, waiting for the party’s next move.
